scope: 32 observed quantities plus8 distinct scientific functionals; finite research portfolio, not a complete description of biology

score_policy.denominator: Only a ratified immutable profile fixes unique task IDs and weights; this catalogue is not a40-vote score
score_policy.views: Question families and biological domains are alternate partitions/overlapping labels, never added together
score_policy.hierarchy: Proposed AB1 current-state+population+longitudinal portfolio; AB2 inherits all AB1 with no weaker limits and adds controlled effects/heterogeneity/transfer; final profile must identify exact subset and weights
score_policy.neural: Direct neural observation can satisfy observational neural tasks; intervention required only for named neural-causal target; TMS is not universal gate
score_policy.unknown: Unqualified operator/noise/linkage stays unknown, known absent required role fails; never0variance
score_policy.aliases: Alias/unit conversion binds canonical target; distinct assay platform requires bridge, not extra target weight
score_policy.genomics: Germline variants are immutable modifier/linkage context; not mutable response targets
